before_question.question: Using the classic Filch Wild flare, what items may you illicitly take and to where, when must the flare be revealed and when may it be zapped, what happens if caught, and what changes about the deck/discards after it is revealed?

after_question.question: Using the classic Filch Wild flare, what items may you illicitly take and from which locations, where may the retrieved ships go, when must the flare be revealed and when may it be zapped, what happens if caught, and what changes about the deck/discards after it is revealed?

required_facts: May illicitly take own ships from warp to colonies or cards from deck/discard even without entitlement.
Does not need reveal unless caught, then may be zapped.
If caught lose one ship to warp and return items caught filching.
Once revealed deck/discards placed next to user for access.
contextual_background: Only one of standard and classic Filch flare is used; any-phase/as-any-player printed usage.
source_references: Rulebook p5 printed classic Filch Wild illustration

primary_source: Original rulebook p5 classic Filch Wild illustration, extraction lines399–413
operative_source_boundary: The text explicitly supplies warp ships to colonies and card sources deck/discard; it does not explicitly supply an illicit-card destination. No destination is invented.
independent_primary_source_adjudication: Continuing reviewer02 own original rulebook/FAQ/native-source review, message and forthcoming alien-cross-source-continuation-02.json; no explicit illicit-card destination found.
reason: The original broad to-where phrase could demand a detail absent from supplied primary effect text. Current wording asks both item sources and the expressly printed ship destination. All other sourced classic Filch mechanics and every raw key fact remain.
